providers.title: Preprocessing
providers.scope: Deleting empty, repeated and contained strings keeps all common superstrings; the substring set V has O(L^2) elements and no element of V properly contains a required string.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Reading a walk
providers.scope: A closed walk from the empty word visiting all required strings spells a common superstring whose length is the cost of the walk.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Euler tours
providers.scope: A balanced finite multiset of directed edges with connected support has a closed walk using every edge once.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Superstrings from balanced multisets
providers.scope: A balanced multiset with connected support containing the empty word and all required strings gives a common superstring of length equal to its number of up edges.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Factor-2 approximation (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A deterministic polynomial-time algorithm outputs a common superstring of length at most 2 OPT.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Blocked occurrences
providers.scope: B_A(s; N_T) is the number of blocked occurrences of s in T, at most N_T(s).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Occurrence lower bound (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The forced counts satisfy m(s) <= N_T(s) for every common superstring T; hence W = sum of m(c) <= OPT.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The base graph (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The base graph is balanced, contains every required string, and has W up edges and W down edges.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Windows of a closed walk
providers.scope: On the lift of a closed walk, every window [x,e) spells the current word A[x,e) of the walk's periodic text.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Recorded occurrences (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every decomposition of the base graph into closed walks, the recorded occurrences of s number m(s).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ordered layers (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The walks of a group can be replaced, edge for edge, by pointwise ordered layers of turn length the least period p; all layers together cost W.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matching window (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Blocked recorded occurrences number B_A(s;m); every unblocked one lies in a layer window agreeing with the template throughout.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Agreement bounds
providers.scope: Different periodic texts of periods p and q agree on fewer than p + q consecutive positions (fewer than p if both have period p).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Maximal rotation
providers.scope: A different text of period q whose forward words are at most the maximal forward word of A at t cannot agree with A on the q positions starting at t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Following ordered windows
providers.scope: Windows with nondecreasing starts and ends are joined by a walk of cost equal to the increase of the ends.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Joining an ordered band
providers.scope: Layers of one group with H - E <= h, h a multiple of p, are joined at cost at most h.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Collective link (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Under (2.1), k layers of period p are attached to a record at cost kp.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Host requests (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A host and all layers requesting a connection at its records are rooted with the host's budget and the requesters' budgets.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Choosing k (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The threshold search stops with 1 <= k <= n, the top k layers form a narrow band, and at most k recorded occurrences of the shortened word have the group's own alignment.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Partition into rooted layers and blocks (OpenAI)
providers.scope: After processing, every layer is rooted or belongs to exactly one block with a reserved planned link.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A short contact on a maximal link (OpenAI)
providers.scope: On a cycle of blocks, the link of the block with the largest forward word reaches a word no longer than the period of its target.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Connecting the base graph (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Closed walks of total cost at most W connect every layer to the empty word.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
